name: Yuma
description: Human ranger and former Riveteer from New Capenna who fled through an Omenpath to Thunder Junction and opened a bar.

timeline.summary: Elnor arrives at Yuma's bar with a fire-breathing snake demon on her arm and fires a warning shot of flame.
timeline.quote: The thing shot a jet of flame from its mouth, hot as a cremation in winter.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Elnor demands to know where the money went, and Yuma retorts.
timeline.quote: "Where did the money go, Yuma?"

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: In flashback, Yuma and Elnor team up with Shadress and others, leave the Riveteers and try to build a collective in an empty warehouse.
timeline.quote: We would leave the Riveteers, where we'd all spent our youth.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: In flashback, the squat's owner impounds their gear, so the crew turns to crime to pay the back rent.
timeline.quote: So, obviously, it would have to be crime, the main industry in New Capenna.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: In flashback, the crew blows safes and robs trains while Elnor charms guards and clerks.
timeline.quote: we blew safes and teased open vaults, we muscled our way through trains on rickety bridges.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: In flashback, the crew borrows money to buy a building, a decision that leads to layers of debt and enemies.
timeline.quote: We borrowed the money to buy it.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Yuma runs off down the Omenpaths, abandoning his friends and taking the money.
timeline.quote: Just ran off down the Omenpaths, not knowing where I was going.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Yuma throws a bottle at the snake demon and stuns it, then gets his thunder bow working.
timeline.quote: the bottle shattered against the creature, making its jet of fire blue for a second.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Elnor says she has been hunting Yuma for a year and he says the money is gone.
timeline.quote: The money's gone. I spent it.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: In flashback, Yuma arrives in Omenport a year ago with the money sewn into his suit, walks into the desert and nearly dies of heat exhaustion.
timeline.quote: Heat exhaustion comes up on you unawares is what I've learned since then.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: In flashback, Yuma meets the baby cactusfolk Kirri, who leads him to a dry riverbed and saves his life.
timeline.quote: Low ground turned out to be a dry riverbed, cool water under the sand. So, I lived.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Yuma reveals the money is the bar itself, which he runs with his staff as a collective.
timeline.quote: "Fine. I lied. It's not gone. You're standing in it."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Elnor snaps her fingers and the fight resumes, with both of them missing and bottles being vaporized.
timeline.quote: She snapped her fingers; the snake came to attention.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Yuma runs for the mezzanine and Elnor sets the staircase on fire behind him.
timeline.quote: she aimed calm as you please and set the stairs on fire behind me.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Yuma blocks a jet of flame with his forearm, which is badly burned, while Kirri watches from a hole in the wall.
timeline.quote: I raised my forearm instinctively against the jet of flame, felt the fire hit it, and screamed in pain.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Yuma recalls the train heist and realizes that Elnor now fights like Shadress, meaning Shadress is dead.
timeline.quote: She was fighting like Shadress .

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Yuma shatters the bar mirror with his thunder bow and fights Elnor hand to hand, throwing the snake demon off her.
timeline.quote: I fired my thunder bow at the long mirror behind the bar.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: A sudden desert rain puts out the fires, and Yuma pins Elnor, choosing not to kill her.
timeline.quote: And then I knelt on her sternum, grabbed her wrists, and it was done.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Yuma tells Elnor the past is dead and that Thunder Junction is a place to invent yourself.
timeline.quote: "The past is dead," I said. "It's over."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kirri makes vines grow through the burnt saloon, filling the holes with red flowers.
timeline.quote: Kirri just invented them.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Elnor concedes, retrieves her snake and leaves without looking back.
timeline.quote: She walked out without looking back.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: After the invasion Elnor, Shadress, Yuma and others leave the Riveteers to found a co-operative.
timeline.quote: to leave the Riveteers and start their own co-operative

citation.work: Elnor
citation.text: "Elnor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Debt, enemies and a failed robbery leave the group poor; Shadress dies and Yuma flees through an Omenpath with the last money.
timeline.quote: Yuma abandoned the group with the last of its funds

citation.work: Elnor
citation.text: "Elnor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elnor follows through the Omenpath to Thunder Junction and confronts Yuma at his bar with fire.
timeline.quote: She entered Yuma 's bar with fire literally in her hands

citation.work: Elnor
citation.text: "Elnor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rain and Kirri's cactus magic end the fight; Elnor lets bygones be bygones and leaves with the snake demon.
timeline.quote: Elnor agreed to let bygones be bygones and left with the snake demon to forge a new life of her own.

citation.work: Elnor
citation.text: "Elnor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yuma leaves the Riveteers after the Phyrexian Invasion for Thunder Junction.
timeline.quote: Left the Riveteers after the Phyrexian Invasion to start a new life on

citation.work: Riveteers
citation.text: "Riveteers", section "Members". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Shadress proposes buying a building; the debt drives the group into crime.
timeline.quote: The debt they incurred led them into a spiral of crime

citation.work: Shadress
citation.text: "Shadress", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A failed robbery on a Brokers-controlled train leaves the group poor and splintering.
timeline.quote: A failed robbery on a Brokers -controlled train left the group poor and splintering.

citation.work: Shadress
citation.text: "Shadress", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Shadress is implied to have died, inferred from Elnor's changed fighting style.
timeline.quote: it's implied that she died sometime after the train heist

citation.work: Shadress
citation.text: "Shadress", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yuma, Elnor, Shadress and others leave the Riveteers to start a co-operative.
timeline.quote: left the Riveteers to start their own co-operative

citation.work: Yuma
citation.text: "Yuma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Overwhelmed by debt and enemies, Yuma flees through a random Omenpath with the remaining money.
timeline.quote: ran through a random Omenpath with all the money they had left

citation.work: Yuma
citation.text: "Yuma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yuma takes in an infant cactusfolk he names Kirri and opens a bar.
timeline.quote: Yuma encountered an infant cactusfolk he named Kirri and took him under his care

citation.work: Yuma
citation.text: "Yuma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elnor arrives to reclaim the money; they shoot it out until Kirri intervenes and Yuma talks her into moving on.
timeline.quote: He was able to talk her into moving on after Kirri intervened in the fight.

citation.work: Yuma
citation.text: "Yuma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Elnor hunts Yuma for revenge over the stolen money.
relations.quote: But she was here for revenge, and I knew she wouldn't hold the next shot back.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

relations.note: confronted him over the stolen money
relations.quote: She demanded answers about the money that had been taken

citation.work: Elnor
citation.text: "Elnor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: The narrator, a former Riveteer weaponsmith from New Capenna who fled to Thunder Junction and now owns a saloon with his cactusfolk friend Kirri.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

pages_say.description: A proud protector who speaks of a green companion in flavor text.
